source.literal_critical_condition: V subset dom partial f, not merely V subset dom f

inputs: Same arbitrary real normed E, d and algebraic e:E equiv_linear EuclideanSpace R (Fin d) as the installed forward adapter; no isometry or substituted norm.
SourceProper f, literal Convex R V, real lambda>=0.
For every p in V the actual global SourceSubdifferential of (f composed e.symm) at e(p) is nonempty. This spells out the printed V subset dom partial f assumption.
Do not add V subset effectiveDomain f: derive it internally from SourceProper, the global finite witness and the existing subgradient_point_finite theorem.

proposed_conclusion.left: Exact existing EReal strong interpolation for all x,y in V and 0<a<1, coefficient lambda/2*a*(1-a)*norm_E(x-y)^2.
proposed_conclusion.right: For all p,q in V and every actual global coordinate subgradient g at e(p), f(p).toReal + inner(g,e(q-p)) + lambda/2*norm_E(q-p)^2 <= f(q).toReal.
proposed_conclusion.finite_value_transport: Both endpoints and every feasible segment point are genuinely finite by derived domain inclusion, so toReal formulation is explicitly equivalent to the printed extended-real inequality.

dependency_ready_route: Transport SourceProper to f composed e.symm using the actual algebraic bijection; apply existing subgradient_point_finite to each supplied global support to derive original feasible-point finiteness.
Forward direction genuinely uses installed stronglyConvex_sourceSubgradient_growth with original f,V,norm,lambda and each supplied g; no support-existence producer is claimed.

Converse: for z=a*x+(1-a)*y in V, choose one of the actual global subgradients at z from the source assumption. Apply the right-hand growth inequality to (z,x) and (z,y), multiply by a and (1-a), then cancel the two linear pairings using e linearity.
Original-norm homogeneity yields norm(x-z)^2=(1-a)^2*norm(x-y)^2 and norm(y-z)^2=a^2*norm(x-y)^2. Weighted sum produces exactly lambda/2*a*(1-a)*norm(x-y)^2.
Transport the resulting real inequality back to EReal using internally established finite values. Empty V and lambda=0 remain included.

Separate the printed proof equality typo from the valid iff statement: proving the stated iff need not assert the erroneous equality or produce all-point supports from convexity alone.
